The PS5 Slim Got An Internal Facelift Again

By Gabriel Stanford-Reisinger October 3, 2026 0 comments · 1 min read
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

Sony’s improved the base PlayStation 5 Slim again, these small tweaks won’t make a world of a difference to standard users, but they’re still nice.

A Polish console and controller technician dug into the small improvements made starting with the Marvel’s Wolverine-themed PS5. Beyond small tweaks like changed cooling, which is more in line with their PS5 Pro now, you have a simplified internal layout, an optimized motherboard, and different heatsink.

One of the key things, though, that I think is really interesting is it’s actually now a lot more service-friendly with these models, as the console is more readily able to get its CR2032 battery replaced, giving way to people being able to fix that sort of problem themselves.
